evidence.summary: Assumption-inversion pass in the active Codex task: checked all 1234 CET6 text tasks across 110 boxes against their visible material, choices or bank, reference answers and explanations. Replaced generic or misleading writing, cloze and vocabulary tasks, completed missing reading statements, corrected removal-versus-retention keys, and corrected translation alternatives, grammatical overclaims and unsupported inference. Whole-sentence translations use reference comparison instead of falsely unique automatic grading. Source claims are explicitly synthetic; historical exam labels are not treated as verified. Audio transcript and pedagogical target text were reviewed; no perceptual audio acceptance is claimed.

Failure-projection pass in the same active task, with a different perturbation context: tested whether a plausible alternative answer, changed quantifier, time shift, swapped actor, coordinated object, missing source passage, nested modifier or translated purpose could invalidate the reference. Corrections include full relative-clause meaning, no less versus as, conditional uncertainty, comparative direction, content-versus-relative clauses, legal preposition stranding and consistent lock mirrors. Runtime export completed 1234 cards and 328 exact audio assets. The audit has zero hard blockers and zero review gaps. Its 859 length-under-90-character signals were examined as concise single-card explanations and retained where they directly explain this task; no padding was added merely to defeat the heuristic. The 1234 synthetic-source flags are explicit provenance boundaries, not claims of authentic exam material.
